div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center;

span.p:
16-bit word
at PC

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center;

span.p:
opcode
[15:13]

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center;

span.p:
PULL [p, l] [d]
shift_reg ← TX FIFO head
takes 1 + d cycles
after any stall

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center;

span.p:
PUSH [p, l] [d]
RX FIFO ← in_shift_reg
(register keeps its value)
takes 1 + d cycles
after any stall

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center;

span.p:
NOP [d]
nothing changes
takes 1 + d cycles

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center;

span.p:
SET p, l [d]
gpio[p] ← l
other pins unchanged
takes 1 + d cycles

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center;

span.p:
SHIFT_OUT [p, l] [d]
gpio[0] ← next bit, then shift:
shift_dir 0: shift_reg[0], >> 1
shift_dir 1: shift_reg[7], << 1
takes 1 + d cycles

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center;

span.p:
SHIFT_IN i [p, l] [d]
bit = gpio_in[i] at cycle start
shift_dir 0: >> 1, then [7] ← bit
shift_dir 1: << 1, then [0] ← bit
(of in_shift_reg)
takes 1 + d cycles

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center;

span.p:
CONFIG f, v [p, l] [d]
config[f] ← v
f = 0: shift_dir
f = 1: open_drain[1:0]
f = 2: open_drain[3:2]
takes 1 + d cycles

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center;

span.p:
WAIT i, v [p, l] [d]
stall while gpio_in[i] != v
(read at cycle start, like SHIFT_IN)
takes 1 + d cycles
after any stall

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center; width: 260px;

span.p:
SKIP_RUN n, v [d] / SKIP_NORUN n, v [d]
reads the newest n bits of in_shift_reg
pins, registers unchanged, no side effect
takes 1 + d cycles

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center; width: 260px;

span.p:
the newest n all v ? (RUN) / not all v ? (NORUN)
PC ← PC + 2 : PC + 1

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center; width: 260px;

span.p:
ACC_IN p / ACC_CRC p / ACC_OUT p / ACC_LOAD [d]
IN: acc ← acc << 1 | gpio_in[p]
CRC: acc ← (acc << 1) ^ (acc[15] ^ gpio_in[p] ? poly : 0)
OUT: gpio[p] ← acc[15], acc ← acc << 1
LOAD: poly ← {shift_reg, poly[15:8]}
no side effect, takes 1 + d cycles

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center;

span.p:
ACC_PUSH [d]
RX FIFO ← acc[7:0], acc ← acc >> 8
takes 1 + d cycles
after any stall

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center;

span.p:
SKIP b, v [p, l] [d]
reads in_shift_reg[b]
pins, registers unchanged
takes 1 + d cycles

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center;

span.p:
JMP target [d]
pins, registers unchanged
no side effect
takes 1 + d cycles

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center; width: 260px;

span.p:
REPEAT count, label
rc == 0 ? rc ← count − 1 : rc ← rc − 1
(rc moves on no other cycle)
pins, registers unchanged
no side effect, no delay
takes 1 cycle

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center;

span.p: PC ← PC + 1

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center;

span.p: PC ← target

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center;

span.p:
in_shift_reg[b] == v ?
PC ← PC + 2 : PC + 1

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center;

span.p:
rc != 0 ?
PC ← PC − back : PC + 1

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center;

span.p:
halt
pins keep their levels

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center; width: 260px;

span.p:
side effect [p, l]
on every instruction but JMP, REPEAT,
SKIP_RUN / SKIP_NORUN and the ACC words:
gpio[p] ← l on the first cycle,
the same edge as the operation
(after any stall)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center;

span.p:
PC past last
instruction?
